title: Leveraging Large Language Models and Topic Modeling for Toxicity Classification

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating how the personal and demographic identities of annotators influence gold standard labels and model predictions by testing fine-tuned models on the NLPositionality benchmark dataset.

Comparing toxicity classification performance metrics (Micro F1, Precision, Recall, True Positive Rate, False Positive Rate) across data subsets grouped by the self-identified racial and ethnic metadata of the annotators (Asian, Black, Latino/Latina, Native American, Pacific Islander, White).

Comparing toxicity classification performance metrics (Micro F1, Precision, Recall, True Positive Rate, False Positive Rate) across data subsets grouped by the self-identified gender metadata of the annotators (man, woman, non-binary).
